setting: You all work at a small independent design studio of five in Ancoats, Manchester, and you have been colleagues for about three years. Hannah leads most client projects, Dev is the senior designer, Tom is the junior designer who handles layouts and exports, and Sadia is the studio director who signs off on work and deals with billing. You all know each other's working habits, your partners and kids by name, and roughly where each of you lives. The last thing the group chat was about was whether the pub quiz team should be called something dreadful, which ended with Tom losing the vote. The project you share is a brand identity and website rebrand for a regional food producer. It was due next Wednesday, and the client has just moved the final delivery to this Friday, 27 November. Everyone knows the typography and colour work is nearly finished and the website build is the part at risk.
